rules.logic: BIOC(MP-031 Share Enumeration Output Written to found_shares.txt) AND BIOC(MP-031 Encryptor Copied to Admin Share Path and Run Detached with no_impl key) AND (IOC(file-sha256 from the report on panw_ngfw_threat_raw) OR ABIOC(MP-031 Rclone Massive Upload to Rare External Destination) OR IOC(ipv4 91.238.181.238)) AND BIOC(MP-031 Renamed Binary Run as rclone from ProgramData with rclone conf) AND BIOC(MP-031 Mass Kill of vmx Named Virtual Machine Processes) AND BIOC(MP-031 Locker Encrypts vmfs Datastore Files to kcr5umw with Ransom Note) within 3600s on the same src_host (agent_hostname on xdr_data; endpoint_device_name on the NGFW records) -> one incident naming the encryptor hashes, the Rclone exfil IP and the stop-wipe-encrypt sequence.
